Her attendance highlights the growing international networking of conservative political movements, providing transparency on their ideological alignment.

The error is in the WHO plane; she claims to represent the marginalized, but her actions serve the interests of a global elite network. It is a classic bait-and-switch.

By adopting populist language to mask elite status, the senator uses projection to deflect from her own record. This creates a pretext of shared struggle to maintain power while ignoring the actual needs of her constituents.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. The divergence between rhetoric and record creates systemic instability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Political elites often adopt populist rhetoric to maintain relevance.

The Unavoidable Lie: That these politicians are truly outside the establishment they serve.
